title: Automated Batch Distillation Process Simulation for a Large Hybrid Dataset for Deep Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2604.09166v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) in chemical processes based on deep learning offers significant opportunities but requires large, diverse, and well-annotated training datasets that are rarely available from industrial operations. In a recent work, we introduced a large, fully annotated experimental dataset for batch distillation under normal and anomalous operating conditions. In the present study, we augment this dataset with a corresponding simulation dataset, creating a novel hybrid dataset. The simulation data is generated in an automated workflow with a novel Python-based process simulator that employs a tailored index-reduction strategy for the underlying differential-algebraic equations. Leveraging the rich metadata and structured anomaly annotations of the experimental database, experimental records are automatically translated into simulation scenarios. translated_title: 面向深度异常检测大型混合数据集的自动化间歇蒸馏过程仿真
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的化工过程异常检测（AD）提供了重大机遇，但需要大型、多样化且标注完善的训练数据集，而这些数据集在工业运行中很难获得。在最近的工作中，我们引入了一个大型、完全标注的实验数据集，涵盖正常和异常操作条件下的间歇蒸馏过程。在本研究中，我们通过相应的仿真数据集对该数据集进行扩充，构建了一个新颖的混合数据集。仿真数据通过自动化工作流生成，该工作流采用了一种基于Python的新型过程仿真器，该仿真器针对底层的微分代数方程采用了定制的指标约简（index-reduction）策略。利用实验数据库中丰富的元数据和结构化的异常标注，实验记录被自动转换为仿真场景。在对单个参考实验进行校准后，其他实验的动态特性……
tldr: 本研究利用新型Python过程仿真器通过自动化工作流生成仿真数据，与实验数据相结合，构建了一个用于深度学习异常检测的大型混合间歇蒸馏数据集。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a large hybrid dataset for deep anomaly detection by combining experimental batch distillation data with automatically generated simulation data from a novel Python-based process simulator.
